unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U08: Distinguish condition,warranty and the effect of waiver or acceptance

payload.title: The legal effect is not settled by the heading
payload.core_explanation_md:
A condition concerns an essential part of the sale purpose; its breach can support the applicable repudiation remedy. A warranty is collateral and normally leads to the described damages remedy. Calling a term warranty does not necessarily settle its legal character. Examine the contract and the importance of the obligation.

The buyer election, waiver, acceptance and relevant severability terms can change how a breach is treated. Do not promise automatic rejection after every nonconformity or assume acceptance eliminates every damages claim. A bank evaluating financed goods needs the actual breach, transaction stage and remedy position, not just a contract heading.

self_check.prompt_text: Does the word warranty in a heading conclusively decide the term legal character?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The contract substance and applicable law matter.

payload.stem_md: A central performance requirement is labelled warranty and the reviewer refuses to examine its substance. What is missing?

options.explanation_md: That does not determine the term role.

options.text_md: A rule that headings always override substance
The importance and legal character of the obligation in the actual contract
A presumption that every term permits rejection
options.explanation_md: Remedies differ with the term and facts.

payload.stem_md: A buyer has accepted goods and seeks automatic rejection for any later defect without examining the contract or statutory qualifications. What is required?

options.text_md: Review the breach, acceptance, waiver and applicable remedy conditions
options.explanation_md: Acceptance can matter without eliminating every claim.

options.text_md: Assume every complaint has been waived
options.explanation_md: That is an unsupported opposite extreme.

options.text_md: Treat damages and rejection as identical

options.explanation_md: The stage is material to the remedy.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Acceptance can matter without eliminating every claim.
